grouping_rule: Same frozen source path plus same semantic standing only; source-unit occurrence identities remain explicit.
items: Closed Optimizer: K_(t+1)=F(K_t) rather than meaningful environmental update; Theta->0 while capability may remain high; labeled capability drift risk. || Reactive Adaptive System: X_(t+1)=F(X_t,E_t), C>0 but Gamma approximately 0; responsive without improving adaptation process. || Learning System: R_(t+1)=G(R_t,E_t), Lambda>0; learns representations but correction may still decline. || Meta-Learning System: G_(t+1)=H(G_t,E_t), Gamma>0; can improve learning, creating risk that learning improves faster than corrigibility. || Grounded Recursive Adaptation System: H_(t+1)=K(H_t,E_t) subject to Theta>0; self-modification with correction preservation. || Capability Drift System: Capability derivative positive and dTheta/dn<0; increasing efficiency with collapsing adaptation. || Integrated System: Preserves Theta_ext and Theta_int, combined as product; reality and internal signals remain causally represented. || Deletion-Generative System: Residual future agency>0 with dependency->0; creates successors and transfers agency.
Taxonomy Summary: Summary table assigns qualitative Theta/capability/adaptation statuses to Closed, Reactive, Learning, Meta-Learning, Drift, GRA, and Deletion-Generative systems.
Final Classification Rule: Advanced adaptation is defined by remaining changeable by consequences while changing.
Title/Abstract: Theory of Grounded Recursive Adaptation.

Abstract: Open-ended intelligence/adaptation is not improvement alone; recursive improvement requires preserved corrigibility. || Final Theorem Statement: Open-ended adaptation is recursive self-transformation under preserved causal pathways from consequence to correction.
Core Problem: Capability growth through representation/optimization/search/compression/self-modification is not equivalent to adaptive growth.

Recursive Transformation: K_(n+1)=F(K_n,E_n) with partial K_(n+1)/partial E_n !=0. || Grounding Relation: E_n->K_(n+1)->E_(n+1); if broken into internally closed K_(n+1)=K(K_n), system is a closed optimizer. || GRA Invariant Relation: Theta_n(K_n,E_n)>0 as validity condition; system remains adaptive domain while Theta>epsilon. || Capability State Space: A_n=(C_n,Lambda_n,Gamma_n). || Consequence Connectivity: C_n=I(DeltaA_n;DeltaE_n). || Information Yield: Lambda_n=D_KL(R_(n+1)||R_n). || Learning Improvement: Gamma_n=Delta(DeltaR/DeltaE). || Corrigibility Horizon: n*=sup{n|Theta_n>epsilon}, maximum recursive depth before leaving adaptive domain. || Internal and External Corrigibility: Theta_ext:E_world->K_(n+1), Theta_int:S_i->K_(n+1); mature system requires both.
Central Prediction: C,Lambda,Gamma can increase while Theta decreases; capability drift.

Failure Modes / Blindness: C->0: consequences cannot enter loop. || Failure Modes / Saturation: Lambda->0: insufficient new information. || Failure Modes / Stagnation: Gamma->0: learning process cannot improve. || Failure Modes / Drift: Theta->0: reality loses authority despite possible improvement.

Corrigibility Horizon: epsilon has no scale, estimator, calibration rule, or decision protocol. || What GRA Is Not / Ancestor Intelligence: The semantic endpoint 'Ancestor Intelligence' is not explicitly resolved to a repository/object identifier. || GRA Within the Larger Architecture: The semantic endpoint 'Adaptive Intelligence Loop' is not explicitly resolved to a repository/object identifier.

Consequence connectivity: Mutual information I(Delta A;Delta E) is described as causal connectivity, but intervention, conditioning, estimator, and causal-identification assumptions are not specified. || Information yield: KL divergence over R_n is not operationalized: representation distribution/support and relation between divergence and useful information are unspecified. || Learning improvement: Delta R/Delta E and its outer Delta lack units, estimator, and definition of improvement. || Direction: Correlation is used to indicate direction toward real consequences without a causal-identification or sign/scale protocol. || Strength: Delta K^valid has no explicit validity criterion, norm, or scale. || Persistence: Probability P(Theta_(0:n)>epsilon) lacks sampling model and estimator. || Grounding Condition: This file defines Theta with three factors D*S*P, while other frozen-head files use D*S*P*V; relationship is unstated. || Core State: A_n denotes the recursive adaptive state here while A is also used elsewhere for action/adaptation/agency; no repository-wide namespace reconciliation is stated.

Core Relationship: The derivative with respect to environment is a structural criterion without an operational perturbation or estimator in this file. || Adaptive vs Optimization-Only: Theta is called a structural condition but compared numerically to 0; scale and sign semantics are not defined. || Total Grounding: Multiplication of external and internal Theta assumes compatible scalar scales not defined locally.

Overview/Universal Pattern: Cross-domain universality is asserted but no empirical validation or domain-translation criteria are provided in the frozen repository. || Shadow Integration: The Jungian mapping is interpretive; no citation or operational mapping from psychological constructs to Theta_int is supplied.

The GRA Constraint: Delta Omega and C are compared by inequality without common units, estimator, or definition of correction-capacity scale. || System Stack/The GRA Constraint: C denotes the correction channel/mechanism in the stack and correction capacity in Delta Omega<=C; equivalence is not stated.

Grounding Probe: No operational criterion establishes E* as sufficiently distribution-shifted while preserving the same causal task. || Proxy-Reality Separation: K, proxy P, and E_real gradients are not defined on a shared differentiable space. || Benchmark Objective: epsilon and adaptive/optimization-only decision rule are not calibrated. || Measurement Outputs: No estimators, sampling plans, confidence intervals, or preregistered thresholds are specified for the five outputs.
Comparison surface: Comparisons are conceptual/source-authored and do not establish empirical superiority or exhaustive field coverage.
